detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic portrait photography with refined Chinese classical aesthetics, realistic skin texture, warm natural colors, soft highlight roll-off, and shallow depth of field.

[Shot 1] A single uninterrupted 5-second shot, framed as a chest-up medium close-up. The composition includes <Subject 1> from the crown of her head to just below the upper chest, clearly showing her face, shoulders, Mandarin collar, and the floral embroidery across the upper section of <Subject 2>. Her face remains the primary visual focus. She sits quietly beside <Subject 3> in an elegant, subdued Chinese interior. Her face turns approximately fifteen degrees toward the window while her eyes rest peacefully near the camera. Her posture is poised, her lips remain gently closed, and her expression conveys warmth and quiet contemplation.

The camera stays almost locked, performing only an extremely slow five-percent push-in while maintaining the chest-up framing. The accelerated time-lapse affects only the sunlight and shadows, not the woman’s body movement. From 0.00 to 1.50 seconds, warm afternoon sunlight passes through the lattice window and forms soft geometric patches across one side of her forehead, cheek, shoulder, and qipao collar. From 1.50 to 3.50 seconds, the changing sun angle causes the intricate lattice shadows to travel smoothly across her eyes, nose bridge, lips, opposite cheek, neck, and embroidered upper chest. The passing light briefly illuminates her irises, earrings, individual hair strands, silk texture, and floral embroidery. She performs one slow, natural blink without changing her pose.

From 3.50 to 5.00 seconds, the sunlight gradually deepens into an amber late-afternoon tone. The dappled pattern continues drifting downward across her jawline, neck, shoulders, and qipao embroidery. Fine dust motes shimmer naturally inside the sunbeam, and a few loose strands of blonde hair move almost imperceptibly in a faint indoor breeze. The light and shadow movement remains fluid, graceful, and physically coherent, without abrupt flicker or exposure pumping.

Preserve her facial geometry, upper-body proportions, hairstyle, earrings, qipao collar, and embroidery in every frame. No cuts, no reframing below the chest, no camera shake, no dialogue, no lip movement, no facial warping, no identity drift, no clothing transformation, no duplicated features, no surreal shadows, and no text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

overall_soundscape:
A peaceful traditional Chinese interior with a faint breeze through the wooden window, subtle fabric rustling, and distant garden birds. No speech.
